note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). Event A is a generic fictional event and the consequences are generic fictional objects; no person is drawn and nobody is injured. The two rings are ONLY the supplied grouping: the inner ring holds the consequences supplied as 'Immediate consequence (as supplied)', the outer ring those supplied as 'Subsequent consequence (as supplied) — to be examined', with identical stroke, colour and weight; neither is shown as excluded, lesser or decided. No remoteness or scope doctrine, test, liability, amount, outcome or jurisdiction is stated. The substituted datum is ONE supplied grouping (the tag's value); only its dependent geometry changes: the focus consequence moves between the ring slots given in focusRings. Omitted brief fields (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, 2026-10-05): none — events, causalLinks, alternatives and losses are editable, with the inspect fields (focusTarget, beforeValue, afterValue, detailGeometry, contextLabels); 'origin', 'focusItem' and 'focusRings' are added. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision (standing stress-cap rule, docs/AUTHORING.md item 20, from LAW-0687/0689–0692; subject floor 'Subject ≥ 0.20 of the frame height at rest and hold' (causation-05 LAW-0700 decision, production/SESSION_HANDOFF.md)). True driver: the 1:1 box — the field must reach 0.20 of the frame height while the lens keeps ≥ 1.5×, ≥ 0.35 of the short side and a text-dominated window and the text stays >= 16 px. Fallbacks tried: context over the record and band; record and band side by side under the context; record beside the field inside the context ('stack2'); context beside the record ('side'); the tag over the path or beside it. Measured, rendered at 1080p (2026-10-05; pre-cap copy in production/scratch/causation-08/LAW-0712.stress-precap.json): full counts (six consequences, two accounts, one labelled link, two grouping items) → 1:1 fallback scale k 0.625, lens 0.222 of the short side; four consequences → field 0.174 of the frame height; three consequences → 0.229; no accounts → 0.174; four consequences, one account, one grouping item → 0.229. The stress therefore caps the COUNTS at four consequences (the first four), one account put forward (the first) and one grouping item (the first) — baseline 3 / 0 / 1; the labelled link is kept; every text field keeps its near-maximum length and stays strictly longer than the baseline.
